text:
becca: Quick final coordination for next Tue launch. Need: changelog link, docs preview with runnable snippets, exact canary windows, HubSpot tag + routing, and the engineering quote for the blog. Embargo 11:00 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout and abort thresholds? @sam
sam: Working on it. Proposed ramp: 4% for 12m -> 20% for 25m -> 60% for 30m -> 100%. Abort if 5xx > 0.7% OR p95 > 330ms. Will post canary plan + rollback commands shortly.
aline: Docs preview available: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/159. Includes quickstart (curl + node) and an embeddings example. I can swap model names once sam confirms. Also added UTM examples for blog links.
matt: For inbound leads, use HubSpot tag `launch_q2_primary`. Routing: tag -> marketing/SDR queue. If trial created in 24h OR usage > 50 reqs/day -> escalate to sales/tier1. I'll add the webhook rules to the ops doc.
sam: Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/jkl012. Blurb: "Reduced tail latency for long contexts via adaptive prefix caching and smarter batching; smaller token cost for typical RLHF pipelines." OK to use in blog?
becca: That's perfect. Marketing will pull that sentence verbatim. Also need a 1-line quote from eng about impact for the header.
sam: Quote: "This release reduces tail latency and cost for long-context production workloads by combining adaptive prefix caching with workload-aware batching." Use as-is.
aline: I'll insert the changelog link and quote into the docs PR once you confirm the final commit hash, sam.
becca: Social cadence: blog T+0, short thread at +10, product clip + webinar CTA at +45, follow-up email T+24h. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/scale-smarter. Please confirm we can include the webinar reg URL in the announcement CTA.
matt: Confirmed, include reg link. Also set UTM params: utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=launch_q2_primary.
sam: One note: APAC rollout will be delayed until after full global rollout to avoid cold cache amplification. We'll stage APAC 1h after full rollout.
becca: We want a 15m dry-run T-30m before publish to sanity-check dashboards and rehearse webinar pitch. Who can join?
sam: I'll run health checks at T-25m and bring the rollback ready.
aline: I'll demo the quickstart and a tiny live example at dry-run.
matt: I'll trigger the HubSpot rule verification during the dry-run to ensure tag flows.
sdr-bot: [lead-routing] tag created: launch_q2_primary -> marketing/queue/2981; escalation rule id 7721
becca: Last ask: marketing needs the final changelog commit hash and the docs permalink by EOD today so we can lock the blog and schedule.
sam: Locking commit: jkl012; permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/159#final. Posting the canary playbook in #eng-ops in 10m.
becca: Awesome. I'll draft the embargo ping for T-30m and schedule the social posts. :rocket:
